_comment: Every claim the site makes, with its status. docs/reality.md and the status tables on the pages are generated from this file by admin/build/gen_features.py. shipped means it exists in the repository, runs, and has been exercised; proposed means it is designed (the brief says how) and not built; absent means it is deliberately not in the MVP. A shipped row carries the version that shipped it. rulesHash is the SHA-256 of rulesSource; the gate fails when they disagree.

statuses.shipped: exists in the repository, runs, and was exercised at the version shown
statuses.proposed: designed in the brief, not built; described only in the future tense
statuses.absent: deliberately not in the MVP; comes as a later version or a later site, or never

features.notes: Check 1 of the gate fails on any disagreement.

features.title: Chrome (head, nav, footer, version badge, CSP, canonical) generated into every page from one definition
features.notes: gen_chrome.py --check is part of the gate.

features.title: Markdown twin of every HTML page, links pointing at markdown

features.title: llms.txt, llms-full.txt and sitemap.xml generated on every release
features.notes: llms-full.txt concatenates every twin and every design document.

features.notes: If the reality document does not list it, it does not exist.

features.title: The eight-check release gate, no dependencies
features.notes: Version agreement, internal links, canonical host, leak tripwire, vendor manifest, rules in sync, reality, storage keys.

features.title: The same gate locally and in CI, one command
features.notes: The CI validate job runs gate.py; a release that fails locally fails the same way in CI.

features.title: Every push to dev is a release: version.txt and the commit subject agree, CI tags it
features.notes: Anchors on the newest commit whose subject is 'site vX.Y.Z : ...', asserts the next minor or patch or major .0, backfills missing tags.

features.title: Deploy to GitHub Pages from the validated tree
features.notes: Excludes .git, .github, infra, tests/unit and node_modules. Actions pinned by commit SHA.

features.title: verify-live: the run is red until the live site serves the released version
features.notes: Green does not mean live. Polls version.txt and the homepage badge for up to ten minutes.

features.title: Every third-party file vendored and hashed in vendor/MANIFEST.json; no runtime script from another origin
features.notes: Check 5 of the gate. Today the only vendored file is the family design tokens.

features.title: secrets.sgit.ai served by GitHub Pages over HTTPS
features.notes: verify-live passed on the v0.1.0 run (attempt 2, 2026-10-05) after the DNS record and Pages settings were made.
